energyRt Options

Source: R/options.R
energyRt-options.Rd

Internally used, package-specific options. All options will prioritize R options() values, and fall back to environment variables if undefined. If neither the option nor the environment variable is set, a default value is used.

Checking Option Values

Option values specific to energyRt can be accessed by passing the package name to env.

options::opts(env = "energyRt")

options::opt(x, default, env = "energyRt")

Options

gams_path
Path to the GAMS installation directory. Prefixed to the gams command when solving with a GAMS backend. If unset, gams is resolved on the session PATH.
default: 
NULL
option:

energyRt.gams_path

envvar:

ENERGYRT_GAMS_PATH (evaluated if possible, raw string otherwise)

gdxlib_path
Path to the GAMS Data Exchange (GDX) library, used to read and write *.gdx files. If unset, gams_path is used instead.
default: 
NULL
option:

energyRt.gdxlib_path

envvar:

ENERGYRT_GDXLIB_PATH (evaluated if possible, raw string otherwise)

python_path
Path to the Python installation or environment used by the Pyomo backend. Prefixed to the python command. If unset, python is resolved on the session PATH.
default: 
NULL
option:

energyRt.python_path

envvar:

ENERGYRT_PYTHON_PATH (evaluated if possible, raw string otherwise)

julia_path
Path to the Julia installation used by the JuMP backend. Prefixed to the julia command. If unset, julia is resolved on the session PATH.
default: 
NULL
option:

energyRt.julia_path

envvar:

ENERGYRT_JULIA_PATH (evaluated if possible, raw string otherwise)

glpk_path
Path to a standalone GLPK installation containing the glpsol executable. If unset, the glpsol R package's bundled binary is used when installed, otherwise glpsol is auto-detected on the session PATH -- which on Windows finds the copy bundled with Rtools.
default: 
NULL
option:

energyRt.glpk_path

envvar:

ENERGYRT_GLPK_PATH (evaluated if possible, raw string otherwise)

neos_email
Email address for NEOS Server job submission (required by NEOS). Read from the NEOS_EMAIL environment variable if the option is unset.
default: 
NULL
option:

energyRt.neos_email

envvar:

NEOS_EMAIL (evaluated if possible, raw string otherwise)

neos_endpoint
XML-RPC endpoint of the NEOS Server.
default: 
"https://neos-server.org:3333"
option:

energyRt.neos_endpoint

envvar:

ENERGYRT_NEOS_ENDPOINT (evaluated if possible, raw string otherwise)

solver
Default solver specification, used when a scenario carries none. A named list, normally one of the solver_options presets.
default: 
list(name = "glpk", lang = "GLPK")
option:

energyRt.solver

envvar:

ENERGYRT_SOLVER (evaluated if possible, raw string otherwise)

scenarios_path
Root directory for scenario folders. Scenario paths and solver working directories are built underneath it.
default: 
"scenarios/"
option:

energyRt.scenarios_path

envvar:

ENERGYRT_SCENARIOS_PATH (evaluated if possible, raw string otherwise)

registry_file
Path to the project registry CSV indexing saved models, scenarios and runs. Kept at the project root, a sibling of the scenarios/ and models/ stores, so one registry spans both.
default: 
"energyRt_registry.csv"
option:

energyRt.registry_file

envvar:

ENERGYRT_REGISTRY_FILE (evaluated if possible, raw string otherwise)

models_path
Root directory for the model store, a sibling of the scenarios/ store. save_model() writes one folder per model name underneath it, updated in place; the content hash lives in the entry's model.yml. Scenarios saved with the default embed_model = NULL store their model here and reference it.
default: 
"models/"
option:

energyRt.models_path

envvar:

ENERGYRT_MODELS_PATH (evaluated if possible, raw string otherwise)

repositories_path
Root directory for the repository store. save_repository() writes one folder per repository name underneath it, updated in place; the content hash lives in the entry's repository.yml.
default: 
"repositories/"
option:

energyRt.repositories_path

envvar:

ENERGYRT_REPOSITORIES_PATH (evaluated if possible, raw string otherwise)

datasets_path
Root directory for the dataset store. save_dataset() writes one folder per dataset name underneath it, updated in place; the content hash lives in the entry's dataset.yml.
default: 
"datasets/"
option:

energyRt.datasets_path

envvar:

ENERGYRT_DATASETS_PATH (evaluated if possible, raw string otherwise)

log_file
Optional operation-log CSV. Empty (default) = logging off; a path makes interpolate_model()/solve_scenario()/solve_recursive() append one line per operation. Read it back with read_log().
default: 
""
option:

energyRt.log_file

envvar:

ENERGYRT_LOG_FILE (evaluated if possible, raw string otherwise)

profile_dir
Directory for the interpolation profile log (interp_runs.csv, interp_stages.csv, interp_maps.csv, interp_params.csv -- per-run timing and memory tables, appended after every interpolation). Empty (default) = fall back to the operation log's directory, then to html/logs/ when a project registry exists; no sink = no files written.
default: 
""
option:

energyRt.profile_dir

envvar:

ENERGYRT_PROFILE_DIR (evaluated if possible, raw string otherwise)

reports_path
Default directory for rendered reports of IN-MEMORY objects (treated as temporary output). Reports of saved objects land inside the owning folder (html/reports/, html/reports/) instead.
default: 
"reports/"
option:

energyRt.reports_path

envvar:

ENERGYRT_REPORTS_PATH (evaluated if possible, raw string otherwise)

levcost_cache_path
Default directory for cached levcost results of IN-MEMORY objects (treated as temporary). Results for saved objects are cached inside the owning folder (html/levcost/) instead.
default: 
"levcosts/"
option:

energyRt.levcost_cache_path

envvar:

ENERGYRT_LEVCOST_CACHE_PATH (evaluated if possible, raw string otherwise)

path_builders
Named list of user functions overriding the built-in folder-name derivations (session-local; set with set_path_builder()). Hookable kinds: scenario_dir, store_entry, run_label, slug — see ?path_builders for the contracts.
default: 
list()
option:

energyRt.path_builders

envvar:

ENERGYRT_PATH_BUILDERS (evaluated if possible, raw string otherwise)

storage_format
On-disk table storage format: 'feather' (IPC), 'parquet', or 'csv'; 'arrow' and 'ipc' are aliases for feather. Both support lazy filtered reads. Size depends far more on DICTIONARY ENCODING than on the container: parquet dictionary-encodes repeated strings itself, feather only if the caller passes factors. Measured on a 543k-row table with zstd-15: plain feather 11.8 MB, parquet 1.10 MB either way, feather with factor columns 1.03 MB and 4.5x faster to read.
default: 
"feather"
option:

energyRt.storage_format

envvar:

ENERGYRT_STORAGE_FORMAT (evaluated if possible, raw string otherwise)

storage_compression
Storage compression codec: 'zstd', 'lz4', or 'uncompressed'.
default: 
"zstd"
option:

energyRt.storage_compression

envvar:

ENERGYRT_STORAGE_COMPRESSION (evaluated if possible, raw string otherwise)

storage_compression_level
Storage compression level (codec-dependent; ZSTD supports 1-22).
default: 
15L
option:

energyRt.storage_compression_level

envvar:

ENERGYRT_STORAGE_COMPRESSION_LEVEL (evaluated if possible, raw string otherwise)

exchange_format
Data-exchange format for the JuMP/Pyomo solvers: 'feather' (IPC), 'parquet', or 'csv'. Julia's Arrow.jl reads IPC only. A solver's export_format/import_format overrides this per solve.
default: 
"feather"
option:

energyRt.exchange_format

envvar:

ENERGYRT_EXCHANGE_FORMAT (evaluated if possible, raw string otherwise)

exchange_compression
Exchange compression codec: 'zstd', 'lz4', or 'uncompressed'. Exchange files are written and read within the same solve, so the default trades size for speed.
default: 
"lz4"
option:

energyRt.exchange_compression

envvar:

ENERGYRT_EXCHANGE_COMPRESSION (evaluated if possible, raw string otherwise)

exchange_compression_level
Exchange compression level (codec-dependent; ZSTD supports 1-22). Ignored for lz4.
default: 
15L
option:

energyRt.exchange_compression_level

envvar:

ENERGYRT_EXCHANGE_COMPRESSION_LEVEL (evaluated if possible, raw string otherwise)

fx_equ
Write an fx bound as one equality row rather than a matched pair of lo/up rows.
default: 
TRUE
option:

energyRt.fx_equ

envvar:

ENERGYRT_FX_EQU (evaluated if possible, raw string otherwise)

parent_levels
Keep parameters at a parent geoframe or timeframe alongside the finest level, so a coarse declaration stays readable after interpolation.
default: 
FALSE
option:

energyRt.parent_levels

envvar:

ENERGYRT_PARENT_LEVELS (evaluated if possible, raw string otherwise)

on_missing_input
What interpolation does when a process names an input commodity the model does not declare: "stop", "warn" or "ignore".
default: 
"stop"
option:

energyRt.on_missing_input

envvar:

ENERGYRT_ON_MISSING_INPUT (evaluated if possible, raw string otherwise)

threads
Threads for the data.table operations interpolation runs. 0 means data.table's own default, which is half the physical cores.
default: 
0L
option:

energyRt.threads

envvar:

ENERGYRT_THREADS (evaluated if possible, raw string otherwise)

map_rules
Build mapping parameters from the declared rules rather than the hand-written builders.
default: 
TRUE
option:

energyRt.map_rules

envvar:

ENERGYRT_MAP_RULES (evaluated if possible, raw string otherwise)

map_rules_verify
Diagnostic: build each mapping BOTH ways and compare, which is slow and is for checking a rule change rather than for normal use.
default: 
FALSE
option:

energyRt.map_rules_verify

envvar:

ENERGYRT_MAP_RULES_VERIFY (evaluated if possible, raw string otherwise)

base_maps
Diagnostic: keep the mapping tables a base interpolation produced, so a derived scenario's maps can be compared against them.
default: 
FALSE
option:

energyRt.base_maps

envvar:

ENERGYRT_BASE_MAPS (evaluated if possible, raw string otherwise)

base_maps_verify
Diagnostic: compare a derived scenario's maps against the base's.
default: 
FALSE
option:

energyRt.base_maps_verify

envvar:

ENERGYRT_BASE_MAPS_VERIFY (evaluated if possible, raw string otherwise)

model_checks_stop
Treat a model consistency check as an error instead of a warning. A declaration that cannot bind is a reason to warn, not a reason to refuse to build, so this is off by default.
default: 
FALSE
option:

energyRt.model_checks_stop

envvar:

ENERGYRT_MODEL_CHECKS_STOP (evaluated if possible, raw string otherwise)

mm_keep_wildcards
Keep wildcard (all-NA) key rows when importing a scenario into the matrix backend, instead of expanding them to their members.
default: 
FALSE
option:

energyRt.mm_keep_wildcards

envvar:

ENERGYRT_MM_KEEP_WILDCARDS (evaluated if possible, raw string otherwise)

save_mode
How a saved scenario carries its model: "ref" references the model in its own store, "embed" writes a copy inside the scenario.
default: 
"ref"
option:

energyRt.save_mode

envvar:

ENERGYRT_SAVE_MODE (evaluated if possible, raw string otherwise)

ondisk_min_rows
Smallest table written to its own file; a shorter one stays in scen.RData.
default: 
1e+05
option:

energyRt.ondisk_min_rows

envvar:

ENERGYRT_ONDISK_MIN_ROWS (evaluated if possible, raw string otherwise)

param_ref_min_rows
Smallest parameter table that is referenced from a base scenario rather than copied into a derived one.
default: 
1e+06
option:

energyRt.param_ref_min_rows

envvar:

ENERGYRT_PARAM_REF_MIN_ROWS (evaluated if possible, raw string otherwise)

scen_file_mb_limit
Size at which the saved scenario file (scen.RData) is reported as carrying tables that belong in the stores. Megabytes.
default: 
256
option:

energyRt.scen_file_mb_limit

envvar:

ENERGYRT_SCEN_FILE_MB_LIMIT (evaluated if possible, raw string otherwise)

lazy_hash
Hash a stored object only when its size or timestamp changed. FALSE hashes on every save.
default: 
TRUE
option:

energyRt.lazy_hash

envvar:

ENERGYRT_LAZY_HASH (evaluated if possible, raw string otherwise)

mem_gc_full
Run a full garbage collection before each memory reading in the operation log. Accurate and slow; the default reads the quick probe.
default: 
FALSE
option:

energyRt.mem_gc_full

envvar:

ENERGYRT_MEM_GC_FULL (evaluated if possible, raw string otherwise)

project_root
Directory a relative store path is rooted at. Defaults to a per-session directory under tempdir(), so nothing is written outside the session unless open_project() or a set_*_path() call says where.
default: 
quote(file.path(tempdir(), "energyRt"))
option:

energyRt.project_root

envvar:

ENERGYRT_PROJECT_ROOT (evaluated if possible, raw string otherwise)

verbose
Verbosity level, logical or integer: 0/FALSE silent, 1/TRUE reports each ACTION once -- what was written, loaded or solved, and where -- and 2 and above add per-object and per-parameter detail. Test with isVerbose(level). This option is the single control: a function's own verbose argument defaults to it, and passing one overrides it for that call.
default: 
1
option:

energyRt.verbose

envvar:

ENERGYRT_VERBOSE (evaluated if possible, raw string otherwise)

debug
Debug level, in the same 0/1/2 form as verbose. Enables internal consistency warnings that are silent in normal use. Test with isDebug(level).
default: 
0
option:

energyRt.debug

envvar:

ENERGYRT_DEBUG (evaluated if possible, raw string otherwise)

progress_bar
Whether long-running operations display a progress bar. Set through show_progress_bar() / set_progress_bar().
default: 
TRUE
option:

energyRt.progress_bar

envvar:

ENERGYRT_PROGRESS_BAR (evaluated if possible, raw string otherwise)
